title: Measurement Integrity in Peer Prediction: A Peer Assessment Case Study
reasoning: The paper introduces 'measurement integrity' as a novel property for peer prediction mechanisms, which is explicitly motivated by and related to 'ex post reward fairness'. The abstract and introduction frame the work around fairness concerns in applications like peer assessment, asking questions such as 'Was my reward fair compensation for my effort?'. This focus on fairness as a core desideratum for the proposed mechanisms constitutes an evaluation component related to ethics.
